description: Calque Batch 1: Vietnamese 'mở' maps to both 'open' and 'turn on', so learners say 'open the TV' for an appliance. Rule en-calque-open-turn-on-appliance rewrites 'open the <whitelisted appliance>' to 'turn on the <appliance>'. Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on the engine WITH calque Batch 1 (MR !281) applied.
fp_risk_note: This calque is high-risk because 'open' is correct for most physical objects. The negatives lock the whitelist boundary: (1) physically-opened objects ('door', 'window', 'box') must keep 'open'; (2) lid-sense devices deliberately CUT from the whitelist ('laptop', 'computer') must NOT be rewritten (you open a laptop lid, not turn it on); (3) head-noun boundary phrases ('open the computer case') must not match on the embedded appliance word; (4) already-correct 'turn on ...' must be left alone. Positives cover the whitelisted appliances only (TV/television/light(s)/radio/fan/air conditioner/AC).
